title: Lindsay Clancy - coming soon
_facts: Trial in Plymouth Superior Court, Massachusetts. On September 4 2026 the judge declared a mistrial after the jury deadlocked across seven days of deliberation. Clancy pleaded not guilty; the jury reached no verdict, and Plymouth District Attorney Tim Cruz has not said whether he will retry the case. Nothing on screen asserts guilt, because nothing has been decided.
